Priya (VP Eng): quick follow-up from today's runtime segment: can the team summarize the kernel+batcher roadmap and any customer-facing SLO risks?
Mateo (Runtime): short summary: kernel refactor (attention v2) -> perf wins, needed for compact KV work. plan: alpha next week, canary in 2 weeks, GA ~10w. main risk: edge seq-len tails impacting p99.
Nora (Bench): initial benches show p95 down ~10% on 1024 ctx, p99 unpredictable on long tails. posting CSVs later.
Lee (SRE): request: add automated rollback based on p99 spike threshold and GPU mem-failure alerts.
Jin (Infra): infra will provision a fixed-size canary pool and a pre-warm job.
Sara (Product): noting customer ask: per-route opt-in during canary and clear docs about expected regressions.
Mateo (Runtime): will post RFC + bench artifacts to eng-runtime and attach a small config example for per-route flags.
Priya (VP Eng): good. please keep the canary windows short and include cost delta estimates. closing thread for updates in eng-runtime.
